name: whossy-rules-tests
description: Emulator tests for the security rules, the payments functions and the notification, presence and popularity triggers. Needs Java for the emulators, and functions/.env.local with APP_FRONTEND_URL for the functions emulator. Runs under a demo project id, so nothing can reach the live project.

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:triggers && npm run test:payments && npm run test:server
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-whossy --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules.security.test.js rules.test.js"
scripts.test:triggers: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-whossy --only firestore,functions,database,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 notifications.test.js presence.test.js popularity.test.js pagination.test.js"
scripts.test:payments: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-whossy --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 payments.test.js"
scripts.test:server: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-whossy --only firestore,functions,database,storage,auth "node --test --test-concurrency=1 server.test.js"
